**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/26 (Fri) 15:07  
[USER] User requested a cheatsheet of Shopify variables for Liquid, specifically mentioning "date, order date, etc."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a cheatsheet of common Shopify variables used in Liquid, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shop.name }}`: The name of the Shopify store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shop.url }}`: The URL of the Shopify store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ customer.name }}`: The name of the customer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ customer.email }}`: The email address of the customer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.name }}`: The name or number of the order.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.order_number }}`: The order number.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.created_at | date: "%B %d, %Y" }}`: The date the order was created in the format "Month Day, Year".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.updated_at | date: "%B %d, %Y" }}`: The date the order was last updated in the format "Month Day, Year".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.total_price }}`: The total price of the order.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ order.line_items }}`: An array of the line items in the order.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ line_item.product.title }}`: The title of the product associated with a line item.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ line_item.quantity }}`: The quantity of the product associated with a line item.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ line_item.price }}`: The price of the product associated with a line item.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.name }}`: The name associated with the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.address1 }}`: The first line of the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.city }}`: The city associated with the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.province }}`: The province or state associated with the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.country }}`: The country associated with the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] `{{ shipping_address.zip }}`: The ZIP or postal code associated with the shipping address.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID
